description_en: Creates a live-to-VOD configuration to store recordings in ApsaraVideo VOD
description_zh: 增加直播录制转点播配置，将录制内容保存到点播媒资库
kebab_example: aliyun live add-live-record-vod-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name testName --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddLiveRecordVodConfig

parameters.help_en: The region ID. The example value `cn-shanghai` indicates the China (Shanghai) region
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The streaming domain.

Ensure ApsaraVideo VOD is activated in the same region as the streaming domain
parameters.help_zh:
主播流域名。
请先确认与此播放域名直播中心相同区域的点播已开通服务
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the application that the stream belongs to. You can find this value on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.help_zh: 播流所属应用名称。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The stream name. You can find this value on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en:
<notice>This parameter is ignored if `RecordFormat` is specified.></notice>
The ID of the ApsaraVideo VOD transcoding template group for transcoding recorded videos
parameters.help_zh:
<notice>当使用按格式配置功能，即传入RecordFormat参数时，此参数无效，可不传。></notice>
对录制后的视频在点播服务中进行一次转码，所使用的点播转码模板组ID
parameters.name: vod_transcode_group_id

parameters.help_en: The cycle duration, in seconds. The default value is 3600. The value must be between 300 and 21600
parameters.help_zh: 周期录制时长。单位：秒。默认值为3600，取值范围：300~21600
parameters.name: cycle_duration

parameters.help_en:
<notice>This parameter is ignored if `RecordFormat` is specified.></notice>
Specifies whether to automatically merge files from multiple recording cycles into a single file after a live stream ends.

A value of ON enables automatic merging. If enabled, you must also specify the `ComposeVodTranscodeGroupId` parameter. By default, automatic merging is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
<notice>当使用按格式配置功能，即传入RecordFormat参数时，此参数无效，可不传。></notice>
在直播录制结束后自动将多个录制周期文件合并成一个录制文件。

设置为ON表示开启自动合并，且必须同时设置请求参数ComposeVodTranscodeGroupId。不传入参数值表示关闭自动合并
parameters.name: auto_compose

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VOD application space. You can obtain this ID from the VOD console or by calling an https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454873.html. This parameter applies only when the VOD application space feature is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 点播应用空间ID，通过点播控制台或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454873.html获取。未开启应用空间时无需填写
parameters.name: space_id

parameters.help_en:
<notice>This parameter is ignored if `RecordFormat` is specified.></notice>
The ID of the ApsaraVideo VOD transcoding template group for transcoding the merged video. This parameter is required if `AutoCompose` is set to `ON`
parameters.help_zh:
<notice>当使用按格式配置功能，即传入RecordFormat参数时，此参数无效，可不传></notice>
对自动合成出来的新视频在点播服务中进行一次转码，所使用的点播转码模板组ID。当AutoCompose为ON时，本参数必填
parameters.name: compose_vod_transcode_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The recording trigger mode. Valid values:

0 (Default): Automatic recording.

1: On-demand recording triggered by an HTTP callback.

2: On-demand recording triggered by ingest parameters.

7: Manual recording. Allows you to start and stop recording by calling the `RealTimeRecordCommand` operation
parameters.help_zh:
录制触发方式，取值：
 
0（默认值）：自动录制。

1：按需录制，通过 HTTP 回调方式。

2：按需录制，通过解析推流参数。

7：手动录制，默认不录制，可以通过 RealTimeRecordCommand 接口手动控制录制开启或停止
parameters.name: on_demand

parameters.help_en:
The recorded content. Valid values:

`raw` (Default): Records the source stream.

`transcode`: Records transcoded streams.

To record both source and transcoded streams, provide a comma-separated list, for example, `raw,transcode`.

If this parameter is set to include `transcode`, you must specify at least one template in the `TranscodeTemplates` parameter
parameters.help_zh:
录制内容。取值：

raw(默认值)：录制源流

transcode：录制转码流

如需同时录制源流和转码流，请将两个取值同时传入,以","分隔，如raw,transcode
录制内容包含transcode时，TranscodeTemplates至少传入一个转码模版
parameters.name: record_content

parameters.help_en: The stream interruption timeout, in seconds. If a stream interruption is shorter than this duration, recording continues in the same file. If the interruption is longer, a new file is created. Valid values: 15 to 21600
parameters.help_zh: 断流拼接时长。 直播断流时长超过设定的拼接时长后，将会生成新文件，断流拼接时长支持 15~21600 秒
parameters.name: delay_time

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically merge recording files for this format after the stream ends. Valid values:

`ON`: Enables automatic merging.

`OFF`: Disables automatic merging
fields.help_zh:
在直播录制结束后自动将多个录制周期文件合并成一个录制文件。取值：

ON：开启自动合并

OFF：关闭自动合并
fields.name: auto_compose

fields.help_zh:
录制格式。取值：
m3u8
flv
mp4
fields.name: format

fields.help_en:
The video processing method. Valid values:

`transcode`: Uses a transcoding template group to process the video.

`workflow`: Uses a workflow to process the video
fields.help_zh:
视频处理方式。取值：

transcode：使用转码模版组处理视频

workflow：使用工作流处理视频
fields.name: process_method

fields.help_en:
The ID of the transcoding template group or workflow.

The specified ID must match the `ProcessMethod`. For example, provide a transcoding template group ID if `ProcessMethod` is `transcode`, or a workflow ID if `ProcessMethod` is `workflow`
fields.help_zh:
视频处理转码模版组ID或工作流模版ID。取值：

此处传入的ID必须与ProcessMethod传入的视频处理方式对应，即ProcessMethod传入transcode，此处应使用转码模版组ID
fields.name: process_template_id

fields.help_en:
The slice duration, in seconds.

This parameter applies only to the `m3u8` format.

The value must be between 5 and 30. The default is 30
fields.help_zh:
单个切片时长。单位：秒。

仅当RecordFormat.N.Format（格式）设为m3u8时，本参数有效。

不填则默认为30秒。取值范围：5s~30s
fields.name: slice_duration

fields.help_en:
The video source to process. Valid values:

`origin` (Default): The per-cycle recording files.

`compose`: The single video file composed from all cycles.

To process both video sources, separate the values with a comma (,), for example, `origin,compose`
fields.help_zh:
视频处理源。取值：

origin(默认值)：处理源视频

compose：处理合并后视频

如需同时处理源视频和合并后视频，请将两个取值同时传入,以","分隔，如origin,compose
fields.name: video_process

parameters.help_en: A list of format-specific recording configurations
parameters.help_zh: 按格式配置录制参数列表
parameters.name: record_format

parameters.help_en: A list of transcoding templates for recording transcoded streams
parameters.help_zh: 转码流录制的转码模板组
parameters.name: transcode_templates
